playable_text_overrides.IR_cherk_return: Commander, return to the main orbital station. My vessel is the nearby mass obstructing your jump; your drive has not been damaged. I need to speak with you through the station liaison.
playable_text_overrides.IR_CHERKASOVA_1a: At {meeting_station_name}, you establish a secure docked liaison with Major Svetlana Cherkasova of the KSR. She apologises for obstructing your departure. Her service has monitored the Sirius investigation through contacts at Korshkov and sent the anonymous SDF intelligence you received earlier. She offers assistance.
playable_text_overrides.IR_CHERKASOVA_1b: Cherkasova explains that the Communist systems oppose Sirius gaining control of Quitolline, despite their differences with GalCop. You share the investigation report: Weiss has been removed from the defence-network assignment, but the software's integrity remains uncertain. The report suggests links between Kinnaird, Sirius and the Edzaar pirates. This is intelligence to investigate, not proof that every allegation is true.
playable_text_overrides.IR_CHERKASOVA_1c: Her SDF source corroborates efforts to cultivate the League of Anarchists. You discuss a possible alliance: radicals are not constrained by the Treaty of Maenes, and Sirius could gain the numbers needed for an assault on orbital facilities. Cherkasova believes control of fuel and Quitolline could threaten the Cooperation. The proposed alliance remains a working theory.
playable_text_overrides.IR_CHERKASOVA_1d: Cherkasova suspects Sirius would discard its pirate allies after the operation. Exposing that risk might break their cooperation. You may confront the anarchists now, or first ask the intelligence sources for more information. Choose only when ready; closing this briefing leaves the decision pending.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_1: You choose to confront the anarchists. Cherkasova will meet you through Edzaar main orbital station's liaison. She also alerts KSR signals posts to monitor Sirius communications. Record the Edzaar lead; this briefing alone does not arrest anyone or complete the confrontation.
playable_text_overrides.IR_sources_1: You choose to seek more intelligence. Cherkasova tasks her SDF contact and signals posts. Through secure station communications, you ask Admiral Ibanez to contact LEXICON and have further findings sent to you. Await the next report.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_brief_1: Meet Cherkasova through Edzaar main orbital station's secure liaison, Galaxy 8.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LEXICON_brief_1: Await further intelligence from GalCop and KSR sources.
